svg.title: Babul-da points to a pond where Riju's map continues a road.
svg.desc: A real pond lies beyond a low wall where Riju's blank digital map shows the road continuing. Babul-da uses the transition from road to water as an ordinary route instruction.
svg.text: Page 8, panel 3 · Over-Babul medium view towards a pond hidden behind a mapped road
